name: Arcane Eye, Hasty
body:
School divination (scrying); Level mesmerist 4, occultist 4, psychic 4, witch 4, wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range Medium (100 ft. +10 ft./level)
Effect magical sensor
Duration 3 rounds
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as arcane eye except as noted above and as follows. The sensor must be created and remain within the spell’s range.
